items.note: S5.1-S5.2 state the lemma (y_S gets y_S+x_S for arbitrary scratch; three stages give (-Y_a,X_a) and restore scratch) and S5.1.1-S5.1.4 follow the proof at 742-763: rows, net change (JV+RG)x, central coefficients |S cap T| mod 2 and (|S cap T|-1)/2. Not carried: h=100, the explicit neighbour rule and the wire counts W_b, W_c (767-783), which lie outside the lemma's proof.

S5.3 states D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, its method is the paper's invariant (stored = frame applied to logical array, checked at sources, edges and gates), S5.3.1 is the commuting step at 811 and S5.3.3 the route formula eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1} at 818-823.

The statement content is all there: nondegenerate triple lines orthogonal for neighbours, F^{otimes3} of dimension m, comparable labels, only central 3->4 edges decreasing by h, L=Ich, sum=Wm-2N+2L, ratios 100/539 and 101/539. The derivation keeps the telescoping (1066-1071) and the side-wire inclusion (945-953, 1048-1055), but it never gives the labels: the terminal labels (881-889), the stage transitions, the gate-label table eq:motif-labels and the per-edge residual table (1022-1043). It also omits the F_2 orthonormal-basis argument (1073-1102).

The rank half follows 1158-1167: rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, the N source edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one, s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, deficit N-2L_b>0. The endpoint identity M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m is only asserted, at S5.9.3. Its proof (P_{U_a^perp}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m; zero source and identity sink on the other roles, 1169-1171) is missing, and so is rho fixing scratch roles (1120-1122).

S5.5 states one kernel aI+bX_v per orthonormal residual vector, s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c<W_c m, and C^{otimes m} on every role. S5.5.1-S5.5.4 follow 1232-1314: weight additivity mod 4, odd weight, conjugation to the translation kernel, the count with no source surcharge, and C^{-1} on the 27 support coordinates corrected by C=iZC^{-1}Z. The explicit frame formula and the k-column extension (1208-1212, 1262-1271) are not stated.

Gives L/N<1/2 and both deficits (N-2L_b, 2N-2L_c), the exact eta_b and eta_c, eta>20*2^{-50}, log m<20, m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20*2^{-50})>m(1-eta) and s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}, exactly as at 1319-1344.

S3 lists the four elementary operations at O(V) correctly. S4's claim drops the hypothesis that the offset can be prepared in b^{O(1)} time, which survives only in its quote, and the hypotheses that q is prime and the denominators are prime to q (557-566). Neither step has a method or sub-steps, so the item is stated rather than derived.

The shear lemma's proof is followed (triangular factors as controlled shifts, E_2 and E_1^{-1}, then Pi D, each one realised with one interchange, a interchanges in all). S5.7 states the factorization A=E_1 Pi E_2 but does not derive it: the pivot elimination of 1376-1391 is missing, as is the choice of the prime avoiding denominators and diagonal numerators (1413-1423).

Follows the proof step by step: cyclic row split into W streams of volume V/W, Phi_{A_e} on each edge by recursive interchanges, the frame identity giving H<-H+D on every role, the three-update interchange, s calls, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with the a<=1 and a>1 cases, the depth-first schedule and the descriptor bound.

Reproduces the proof: rho high digits joined into a row field R=q^{2rho}>=W^k, padding to R'<2R, a base-m split of e-rho into power-width pieces, the geometric cost sum, unpadding, and padding binary ranges to [q^e] with e=O(u). The unequal-width variant (1740-1762) is not in S5.10, but S7.1.10 and S8.6.6 use its peel-a-bit form.

Follows the proof: the eight parity updates with cycles composing to (00 10)(01 11), the guard interval 10<=g<=2^{K-1}-11, delta_bad from 20 excluded values over 2(f-1) guards, T_0 S_0^{-1} permuting B, 16 swaps and 8 rotations, repair by radix sort, the cost terms and the family simplification. Lists the table rows, the margins g_1..g_7 with min g_i=2^{-181}=2kappa, the per-row justifications, setup at p^{A+C}=o(Tp), exceptional sorting o(V), log p factors absorbed by p^kappa, and the schoolbook cutoff, as at 4815-4995. The margin values are quoted rather than derived, because the plan never gives the fixed exponents they come from.

No step explains why the bound refutes the n log n conjecture (an eventual lower bound would need T_A(n)>=c_A n lg n; one machine with liminf zero negates it). Only S0's relies-on tag names the conjecture.

errors.says: Adding an offset computed from earlier control fields to a later field modulo q^b, or multiplying it by a fixed unit, costs O(V).
errors.paper: The O(V) bound holds if the offset can be prepared in b^{O(1)} time from the fixed number of controls, with q a fixed prime and the coefficients' denominators (and, for units, numerators) prime to q.

errors.says: The butterfly H_0 is applied to the selected bit in each of d address chunks.
errors.paper: The layer acts on D consecutive K-bit chunks with 1<=D<=d; d is the size parameter, not the chunk count.

chain: The tree reaches O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}) by the paper's route. S5 builds the two finite networks, frames, labels, rank budget, saving and exponent, the matrix shear and both recurrences; S6 and S7 give the transforms, convolution, resampling and chirp identities; S8 and S9 handle parameters, the CRT map, exact recovery, cost accounting and the cutoff. It thins out at the base of S5: the sizes h, N, m and W are never defined, the subspace labels themselves are never written down, the bit network's endpoint identity and the triangular factorization are asserted rather than derived, and the fixed exponents lambda, c, lambda' and delta are missing, so the layer conditions and the margins g_i are quoted rather than checked.

steps.note: The exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with every scratch value restored, and an eight-row schedule on three-element subsets, are stated. But h=100, the indexing a in T^3, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 never appear, so the network's defining sizes are missing. Conservative verdict.

Has the common frame per gate commuting with pointwise gates, the implemented operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, the route operator eps_w D_sink D_source^{-1}, and edges costing only a change of frame.

Has nondegenerate labels in F^{otimes3} of dimension m, comparable labels on every edge, and only the central 3->4 edges decreasing, each by h (P tensor F). The individual gate labels are not listed, but the step's defining content is present.
Has rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested U in V, sign reversal not changing the rank, and the N source edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one as the only exceptions.
Has the sum of |change in dim| = Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, from telescoping at gates and terminal sums N and Wm-N, then s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b by adding N source ranks.
Has L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, deficit N-2L_b>0 (and 2N-2L_c>0), hence s<Wm.

S5.9.3 states M_out(rho(w))-M_in(w)=I_m and that, through the common-frame identity, every role (scratch included) receives H<-H+D. The computation P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m is not shown, but the step is present in its role.
Has A=E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones, triangular factors at O(V), one interchange per one of Pi, and exactly rank(A) recursive calls per edge, s in all at a node.
Has children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20, and F_k=O(e^tau) by the two-case geometric sum.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the central saving almost completely. Frames, labels, rank equal to dimension change, the budget Wm-2N+2L, the strict deficit from L/N<1/2, the endpoint shear, edges as rank-many recursive calls and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50} are all present in their roles. The weak point is C1: the network's exchange and restoration are stated, but h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are never defined, so the quantities in the budget and the ratio L/N are left without their meaning.
